'''''Mourning Glory''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship captained by [[Grov Bricker]]. It was captured by the [[Hapan]]s during a trip through the [[Transitory Mists]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and crew were eventually released along with ''Mourning Glory'' when the ship's [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]], who turned out to be [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] hiding in disguise, was shot with the [[Gun of Command]] by [[Ta'a Chume]] and ordered him to return home.<ref name="hapan" />
